caption: The drawing features a simple outline of a jug in the upper left corner, rendered in thin blue lines, with a small handle and a partial decorative element on its side. Occupying the lower right portion of the image is an abstract, floral-like pattern also in cobalt blue, consisting of sweeping curved lines, leaf-like shapes, and dotted lines clustered on a brownish, smudged background. The overall color palette consists of blue for the drawn elements and beige to brown for the background, with the blue elements standing out prominently against the lighter, textured surface.
title: Jug
